question: Approve entering ideation to restore the verification-discipline clauses the 3.0 rewrite dropped, under the Production profile, with scope bounded to the clauses that have named evidence plus the one-time migration record — or hold at backlog?

artifacts.summary: Committed seed reviewed at the initial stage. PR #249 replaced kernel.md wholesale (349 lines -> 81; -345/+77), and five clauses merged by #156 plus the absolutes rule merged by #164 did not survive the replacement. Verified today across six recording surfaces (PR #249 body, its 8 sub-commit messages, its review thread which holds 0 reviews and 0 inline comments, MIGRATION.md, RATIONALE.md, CHANGELOG.md): none records the removal. All three proof-stage contracts were read in full and carry required-output lists only, so the rules did not re-site into the profiles; one phrase survives in production/verify.md's mission line, which POC and Pilot never load. Last session paid for the loss twice: a false byte-parity claim passed a Captain gate, and a stopping rule had to be hand-invented mid-flight.
